# AI Tools Atlas

> English summary of 114 AI tools in 13 categories from a Hebrew-language atlas (אטלס כלי בינה מלאכותית): what each tool does, what it costs and what to know before using it. Snapshot dated 2026-11-18. Not updated automatically.

Notes:
- Prices are in each company's original currency, not converted. Each tool says whether its price was verified from an official source.
- A missing field means no reliable source was found, not that the answer is negative (for example, "Hebrew: not mentioned" is not "no Hebrew").
- Check the tool's official site for the current price and terms before deciding.
- Each tool has a link to its card in the atlas (Hebrew) and to its official site.

Atlas: https://kleyai.tech/ | Sources: https://kleyai.tech/sources.html

# Assistants, search and research

## 1. ChatGPT
https://kleyai.tech/#tool-11 | official: https://chatgpt.com | OpenAI
What: General-purpose chat assistant from OpenAI: writing, questions, search and research, files, images and voice.
For: Anyone who needs a general assistant, from students to professionals and teams.
Pros: Broad free plan: unlimited text chat (subject to abuse limits), limited file uploads, image generation, voice, Deep Research and memory | Four personal plans (Free, Go, Plus, Pro). Plus adds Projects, scheduled tasks and custom GPTs; Pro offers three usage tiers | Large context for reasoning models: 256K on Go and Plus, 400K on Pro
Cons: Small context on Free: 27K for the Instant model (about 12 pages of input) | Go may include ads, per the pricing page | Consumer chats are used for training by default unless you opt out in settings or the privacy portal
Price: Plus is 20 USD/month. Free plan exists. Go and Pro prices not verified. (partly verified)
Model: Subscription
Free: Permanent Free plan: unlimited text chat (abuse limits apply), limited uploads, image generation, voice, Deep Research, memory, Codex. 27K context on Instant.
Plans: Free: free; Go: price not verified (More messages, uploads, images and voice than Free; longer memory; 54K context on Instant, 256K on reasoning. May include ads); Plus: 20 USD/month billed monthly (Everything in Go plus advanced reasoning, Projects, scheduled tasks, custom GPTs, extended Codex, early features. Limits apply); Pro: price not verified (Everything in Plus plus 3 usage tiers, Dot agent, unlimited images, max Deep Research and memory, monthly API credits. 128K Instant / 400K reasoning context); Business: price not verified (Monthly or annual billing, 2+ users); Enterprise: custom quote
Privacy: Per OpenAI's policy (updated 13 Mar 2026), chats are used for training unless you opt out via the privacy portal or Data Controls; Temporary Chats are not used. Team, Enterprise and API are not trained on by default. The page does not name Go, Pro or Edu.
Rights: Not verified (terms not read).
API: Yes. Pro includes monthly API credits. API docs and pricing not read.
Hebrew: Source does not mention Hebrew: the interface language list in the help page does not include it. No official page found on model language support.
Students: No student discount on the pricing page. ChatGPT Edu exists for universities (no public price); ChatGPT for Teachers is free for verified US K-12 teachers through June 2027.
Community signals: recommended (at least two independent sources), popular, worthwhile free plan
Watch out: Users report support and refund requests get automated replies only.
Latest version: GPT-6.1 Sol

## 2. Claude
https://kleyai.tech/#tool-12 | official: https://claude.com | Anthropic
What: Assistant from Anthropic for writing, file analysis, research, and creating documents, presentations and code.
For: Students, writers, researchers and developers working with long documents, files and code.
Pros: Many tools free: Free includes web search, file creation, code execution, memory, app connections, Artifacts, Claude Design, Slides and Docs | Annual discount: Pro is 20 USD monthly or 17 USD/month billed yearly (200 USD upfront) | Documented API with public pricing: Opus 5.5 is 4 USD per million input tokens and 20 USD output; also on AWS, Google Cloud and Azure
Cons: Usage is capped per 5-hour window and per week on all plans. Max gives 5x Pro, Ultra 10x | Opus, Claude Code and Research need Pro or above; Free has Sonnet and Haiku and up to 5 Projects | Interface has no Hebrew, though you can write to Claude in any language
Price: Pro is 20 USD/month, or 17 USD/month billed yearly. Free plan with renewing quota. (verified from official source)
Model: Subscription
Free: Permanent Free plan; quota renews per 5-hour window and weekly. Includes Sonnet and Haiku, web search, file creation, code execution, memory, Artifacts, up to 5 Projects.
Plans: Free: free; Pro: 20 USD/month billed monthly (More usage than Free, Opus, Claude Code, Claude Science, unlimited Projects, Research, Claude in Chrome and Microsoft 365, task scheduling, Data, Sheets and Whiteboards (beta)); Pro: 17 USD/month billed yearly; Max: 100 USD/month billed monthly (5x Pro usage per 5 hours and week, Fable up to half the weekly quota, 100 USD/month API credits, early access, priority at peak times); Ultra: 200 USD/month billed monthly (10x Pro weekly, no 5-hour limit (verified accounts), Fable up to half weekly quota, 200 USD/month API credits); Team Standard: 25 USD/month per user billed monthly (2 to 150 users; more usage than Pro, Claude Code, Cowork, SSO, central billing, no training by default); Team Standard: 20 USD/month per user billed yearly; Team Premium: 125 USD/month per user billed monthly (5x Standard seat usage); Team Premium: 100 USD/month per user billed yearly; Enterprise: 20 USD/month per user billed yearly (Minimum 20 seats plus API-rate usage); Education: custom quote (Whole-university plan for students, staff and employees, plus API credits for learning)
Privacy: Per Anthropic's privacy center (16 Mar 2026), consumer Free, Pro and Max chats may improve models if you allow it in the Model Improvement setting; default not stated. Incognito chats are not used. Chats flagged for safety review may be used. Thumb feedback is kept up to 5 years. Team: no training by default.
Rights: Not verified (terms not read).
API: Yes. Claude Platform API. Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) is 4/20 USD per million input/output tokens, 8/40 in fast mode; also on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure. Max and Ultra include monthly API credits.
Hebrew: Source does not mention Hebrew: the official interface languages (English, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish) exclude it. You can chat in any language and it replies in the language you write.
Students: No personal student discount. Education plan for institutions (students, staff, employees), discounted by quote.
Community signals: recommended (at least two independent sources), popular
Watch out: Users report accounts blocked without explanation, and bot-only support.
Latest version: Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-09-22

## 3. Gemini
https://kleyai.tech/#tool-13 | official: https://gemini.google | Google
What: Google's chat assistant for writing, research, image and video generation, and work with Google services.
For: Google users who want an assistant connected to Gmail, storage and Google's creative tools.
Pros: Free plan with many tools: image generation and editing, Deep Research, Gemini Live, Canvas, limited Google Flow access and 15GB storage | Cheap paid tier: Google AI Plus is 4.99 USD/month in the US, 2x Free usage, video generation, 200 Flow credits, 400GB storage | Bundle with storage and Google services: Google AI Pro at 19.99 USD/month has 4x Free usage, 1,000 Flow credits, Antigravity, YouTube Premium Lite and 5TB
Cons: Free is limited to the Flash-Lite model; Gemini 4 Argon needs Google AI Pro or Ultra | Chats may be used for training and human review: with History on, Google trains on chats and some are reviewed by humans and kept up to 3 years | Checked prices are US prices in dollars; other countries not checked
Price: From 4.99 USD/month (Google AI Plus, US price). Free plan exists. (verified from official source)
Model: Subscription
Free: Free with a Google account: Flash-Lite, images, Deep Research, Gemini Live, Canvas, limited Google Flow, 15GB storage. Quota size and renewal not stated.
Trial: Page links to a free trial, but length and terms were not shown or verified.
Plans: Free: free; Google AI Plus: 4.99 USD/month billed monthly (2x Free usage, video generation, Daily Brief, 200 Flow credits, Gemini in Gmail and Vids, 400GB); Google AI Pro: 19.99 USD/month billed monthly (4x Free usage, Gemini 4 Argon, video, 1,000 Flow credits, Antigravity, Google Home Premium (Standard), YouTube Premium Lite, 5TB; 1M-token context per the page FAQ); Google AI Pro: 199.99 USD/year billed yearly; Google AI Ultra: 99.99 USD/month billed monthly (5x Pro usage, max access to Gemini 4 Carbon, Argon and Hydrogen, 10,000 Flow credits, Project Genie, YouTube Premium, from 20TB); Google AI Ultra: 199.99 USD/month billed monthly (Top Ultra tier: 20x Pro usage and 25,000 Flow credits); Gemini with Google Workspace: 14 USD/month per user (Up to 300 seats, 2TB pooled storage per user); Gemini Enterprise: 30 USD/month per user (Unlimited seats and higher quotas)
Privacy: Per the Gemini Apps privacy hub (updated 16 Nov 2026), with History on Google uses future chats to train models; default not stated. Some chats are human-reviewed and kept up to 3 years. You can turn History off or stop training use; temporary chats are not used. Gemini Live audio, video and screen sharing are not used by default. Work and school accounts have different terms.
Rights: Not verified (terms not read).
API: Yes. Google AI Studio and Antigravity are free to start with paid upgrade; Gemini platform is pay-per-use with a free trial. API price list not read.
Hebrew: Not verified: the help page on supported languages and countries did not load.
Students: The plans page links to a 'For Students' area but shows no student price or discount; not verified.
Community signals: popular
Latest version: Gemini 4 Argon, 2026-10-13

## 4. Microsoft Copilot
https://kleyai.tech/#tool-14 | official: https://copilot.microsoft.com | Microsoft
What: Microsoft's chat assistant, free and built into Microsoft 365 apps such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
For: Windows and Microsoft 365 users who want an assistant inside Office tools.
Pros: Copilot inside Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook for desktop with Microsoft 365 Personal, Family and Premium | Bundle with storage and Office: Microsoft 365 Personal is 9.99 USD/month or 99.99 USD/year with 1TB storage | One free month: 'Try free for 1 month' on Personal, Family and Premium, subject to offer terms and region
Cons: Free version is capacity-limited: 'limited free version of Copilot subject to available capacity and limits', no numeric quota | On Family and Premium, AI features are for the subscription owner only and cannot be shared | AI-generated audio is English only on all plans
Price: Basic Copilot is free. Microsoft 365 Personal with Copilot is 9.99 USD/month or 99.99 USD/year. (verified from official source)
Model: Subscription
Free: Limited free Copilot, subject to available capacity and limits. Quota and renewal not published.
Trial: One free month for Personal, Family and Premium. Eligibility, continuation and payment details vary by offer and region.
Plans: Free: free; Microsoft 365 Personal: 9.99 USD/month per account billed monthly (1 user, up to 5 devices, 1TB, Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook on desktop, advanced chat with more usage than Free, image generation); Microsoft 365 Personal: 99.99 USD/year per account billed yearly; Microsoft 365 Family: 12.99 USD/month per account billed monthly (1 to 6 people, 2TB shared. Copilot for the owner only); Microsoft 365 Family: 129.99 USD/year per account billed yearly; Microsoft 365 Premium: 19.99 USD/month per account billed monthly (1 to 6 people (AI for owner only), 2TB, advanced chat with extensive usage, Premium and Pro exclusive features, limited agent use including advanced research); Microsoft 365 Premium: 199.99 USD/year per account billed yearly; Microsoft 365 Pro: 99.99 USD/month per account billed monthly (Up to 6 people, 5TB, highest chat, agent, image and audio usage. Includes everything in Premium)
Privacy: Per Copilot privacy FAQ (updated 11 Mar 2026), Microsoft trains on conversations 'except for certain categories of users or users who have opted out'. Excluded: organization accounts, Copilot inside Microsoft 365 Personal or Family, signed-out users, under-18s and users in several countries including Israel. The page covers the older app version; the current version (since 18 Aug 2026) and web have another privacy page that was not read.
Rights: Not verified (terms not read).
API: Not verified: whether the consumer assistant has an API was not checked.
Hebrew: Not verified: the help page on supported regions and languages did not load.
Students: Per pricing FAQ, students 'may qualify for special Microsoft education offers and discounts', including discounted Microsoft 365; some institutions give access free. No price; eligibility depends on institution and region.
Community signals: popular
Latest version: Updated Copilot app, 2026-08-18

## 5. Perplexity
https://kleyai.tech/#tool-15 | official: https://www.perplexity.ai | Perplexity
What: Answer engine that searches the web and returns a summarized answer with sources, including a deep research mode.
For: Students and researchers who need search-based answers with sources.
Pros: Discount for students: Education Pro is 10 USD/month for verified students and educators via SheerID, everything in Pro plus Learn Mode | Free plan has 'near-unlimited basic searches', 3 Pro searches a day and 1 Research query a month | Pay-per-use API with credit purchase; per the help page no data logging or retention
Cons: Free has no advanced models, image generation or file/app creation, and limited uploads | Pro quotas are weekly and monthly by 'average use', no published numbers | API subscription is separate: no free credits and no access to Pro features in the interface
Price: Free plan exists. Education Pro for verified students is 10 USD/month. Regular Pro price not verified. (partly verified)
Model: Subscription
Free: Free Standard plan: near-unlimited basic searches, 3 Pro searches a day, 1 Research query a month, limited uploads.
Plans: Standard (Free): free; Pro: price not verified (Weekly and monthly quotas by 'average use' for Pro searches, Research, Comet Assistant and files. Advanced models, image and video generation, up to 50 files per project); Education Pro: 10 USD/month billed monthly (Everything in Pro, Perplexity Computer, Learn Mode and advanced models); Max: price not verified (Everything in Pro at 'advanced use' quotas, early access to new products, Brain preview); Enterprise Pro: 40 USD/month per user billed monthly (400 Pro searches/week, 50 Research queries/month, 80 Browser Agent queries/month, no training on data); Enterprise Pro: 400 USD/year per user billed yearly; Enterprise Max: price not verified (4,000 Pro searches/week, 500 Research queries/month)
Privacy: Not verified for personal plans: privacy policy and data-retention help page not read. Per the plans help page, Enterprise Pro data is 'never used for training' and the API does not log or retain data.
Rights: Not verified (terms not read).
API: Yes. Pay-per-use API platform, buy credits or auto-top-up. No free credits. API price list not read.
Hebrew: Not verified: no official page on supported languages found or read.
Students: Education Pro at 10 USD/month for students and educators verified via SheerID, with everything in Pro plus Learn Mode; 'auto-applied' per the discount page. For institutions: Enterprise Pro at 30 USD/user/month or 300/year.
Community signals: recommended (at least two independent sources), popular, worthwhile free plan
Watch out: Users report billing that continued after cancellation and a cumbersome cancellation process.

## 6. DeepSeek
https://kleyai.tech/#tool-16 | official: https://www.deepseek.com | Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd., China
What: Chat assistant from a Chinese company, on web and app, with a cheap pay-per-use API.
For: Users and developers who want a low-cost assistant and API and accept data stored in China.
Pros: Low API price: deepseek-flash input is 0.15-0.3 USD per million tokens, output 0.6-1.2 USD, half price off-peak | New model on web, app and API: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, released 17 Oct 2026
Cons: Data is stored in China: personal data is collected, processed and stored in the People's Republic of China, per the privacy policy | Data used for training; opt-out only by email to privacy@deepseek.com | Free-use terms not published: the official pages show no price or quota for web and app chat
Price: API is pay-per-use, from 0.15 USD per million input tokens. Web and app chat price not verified. (partly verified)
Model: Pay per use
Plans: Chat on web and app: price not verified; API: deepseek-flash: price not verified (Input 0.15-0.3 USD, output 0.6-1.2 USD per million tokens. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017. Cached input 0.003-0.006 USD); API: deepseek-v4-pro: price not verified (Input 0.66-1.32 USD, output 1.98-3.96 USD per million tokens. DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813)
Privacy: Per the privacy policy (last update 10 Feb 2026), one use of data is 'to train and improve our technology'. Users may opt out of training use by email to privacy@deepseek.com. Data is collected, processed and stored in the People's Republic of China.
Rights: Not verified (terms not read).
API: Yes. Pay-per-use API with deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro, half price off-peak. Also a speech API (TTS, ASR) and Search & Fetch at 0.75 USD per 1,000 calls.
Hebrew: Not verified: no official language page read.
Students: No student offer found on the pages checked.
Community signals: popular
Latest version: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, 2026-10-17

## 7. Grok
https://kleyai.tech/#tool-17 | official: https://grok.com | SpaceXAI
What: Chat assistant with voice, image and video generation and build tools, from the makers of Grok at x.ai.
For: Users who want an assistant with voice, images and video on a relatively cheap plan.
Pros: Cheap paid plan: Plus is 8 USD/month with Grok Chat, Voice, Imagine, Build and Grok API access | Quotas refresh weekly. Premium gives 4x Plus, Super 15x, Ultra 50x | API access from Plus; API use is billed separately at model rates and does not draw down the subscription quota
Cons: Free is limited: chat and agent quota is 'Limited', no numbers | Image and video generation and 'Latest Grok models' start at Premium, 30 USD/month | Monthly billing only, before tax: no annual option on the page. 'Prices subject to change'
Price: From 8 USD/month (Plus), before tax. Limited free plan exists. (verified from official source)
Model: Subscription
Free: Free plan with limited chat and agent use. Quotas refresh weekly per the pricing page; free quota size not stated.
Plans: Free: free; Plus: 8 USD/month billed monthly (Shared usage pool, Grok Chat, Voice, Imagine, Build, Grok API access, Cursor); Premium: 30 USD/month billed monthly (4x Plus usage, Grok Bot, newest models, faster answers, images and video, code storage, cloud agents); Super: 100 USD/month billed monthly (15x Plus usage and priority at peak times); Ultra: 200 USD/month billed monthly (50x Plus usage)
Privacy: Not verified: privacy policy and terms not read.
Rights: Not verified (terms not read).
API: Yes. Grok API access included from Plus, billed separately at model rates. Model price list not read.
Hebrew: Not verified: no official language page read.
Students: The pricing page mentions no student offer.
Community signals: popular

## 8. Meta AI
https://kleyai.tech/#tool-18 | official: https://www.meta.ai | Meta
What: Meta's chat assistant, free for everyone, with extended image and video generation in the Meta One subscription.
For: Users of Meta apps who want a free assistant and image and video generation.
Pros: Free for everyone: per the Meta One plans page, Meta AI is free for all users; subscribers get more usage | Cheap subscription for images and video: Meta One Personal Core is 7.99 USD/month with higher AI usage, including image editing and generation, video, voice and effects
Cons: Quotas not published: the page gives no free-plan limits or the size of the subscriber boost | Availability and prices depend on region: Meta One is 'not available in all regions'; prices and features vary by country, app and account
Price: Meta AI is free. Meta One Personal Core subscription is 7.99 USD/month; price varies by country. (partly verified)
Model: Subscription
Free: Meta AI is free for everyone per the page. Quotas and renewal not stated.
Plans: Meta AI (free): free; Meta One Personal: Core: 7.99 USD/month billed monthly (Higher AI usage, including image editing and generation, video, voice and effects); Meta One Personal: Premium: 19.99 USD/month billed monthly (Extended AI usage and more video generation); Meta One Creator: 14.99 USD/month per profile billed monthly (Creator tiers Essential (14.99), Advanced (49.99), Expert (149.00) and Max (499.00) per profile, with higher AI usage for images, video and voice)
Privacy: Not verified: privacy policy and Meta AI terms not read.
Rights: Not verified (terms not read).
API: Not verified: whether the consumer assistant has an API was not checked.
Hebrew: Not verified: no official language page read.

## 9. Mistral Vibe (formerly Le Chat)
https://kleyai.tech/#tool-19 | official: https://mistral.ai/products/vibe/ | Mistral AI
Status: Renamed. Renamed: Le Chat is now Mistral Vibe. Chats, settings and subscriptions move to the new service.
What: Mistral AI's chat assistant (formerly Le Chat) for chat, search, document work and code.
For: Students and users who want a cheap European assistant, including code work.
Pros: Big student discount: verified students at recognized higher-education institutions get Pro at 5.99 USD/month instead of 14.99, for up to 12 months | Available almost everywhere: web, iOS and Android apps, macOS and Windows apps, command line and VS Code, plus JetBrains and Zed via ACP per the page | API credits inside Pro: '15 USD/mo in API credits' and 6x Free messages and searches
Cons: Training on data by default: on Free, Pro, Teams and Student your data is used for training unless you opt out; only Enterprise is excluded by default | Free is limited in messages, searches and code sessions, with basic image generation only | Pro is 14.99 USD/month excluding taxes, with no annual option on the page
Price: Pro is 14.99 USD/month before tax, 5.99 USD for verified students. Free plan exists. (verified from official source)
Model: Subscription
Free: Free plan: limited messages, web searches and code sessions, basic image generation, 100+ connectors. Quota size and renewal not stated.
Plans: Free: free; Pro: 14.99 USD/month billed monthly (Up to 6x Free messages and searches, up to 40x image generation, 15GB library, unlimited scheduled tasks, 15 USD/month API credits); Pro (Student): 5.99 USD/month billed monthly (Pro plan); Team: 24.99 USD/month per user billed monthly (Higher quotas, up to 30GB storage per user, domain verification, data export); Enterprise: custom quote (Custom models and agents, audit logs, SAML SSO)
Privacy: Per Mistral's help center (undated), on Vibe Free, Pro, Teams and Student, input and output data are 'used by default' for model training; opt out any time. Enterprise is excluded by default. Opt-out does not apply to Labs and Public Preview models, and feedback with a comment permits use of that chat on any plan.
Rights: Not verified (terms not read).
API: Yes. Pro includes 15 USD/month in API credits. Mistral Studio has a free mode and a pay-per-use mode. API price list not read.
Hebrew: Source does not mention Hebrew: the product page shows only the site languages (English, French, Italian) and does not list product languages.
Students: Pro at 5.99 USD/month (before tax) instead of 14.99, for verified students at recognized higher-education institutions who have not used Vibe or Le Chat before, for up to 12 months.
Latest version: Mistral Vibe

# Writing, documents and presentations

## 10. Gamma
https://kleyai.tech/#tool-20 | official: https://gamma.app | Gamma
What: Creates presentations, documents and simple websites from a written prompt or an existing file.
For: Students, teachers and independent creators who need a polished presentation or document fast, and teams and organizations.
Pros: Right-to-left support: per the help center, Gamma supports RTL languages including Hebrew. You can prompt in Hebrew and text aligns right automatically | Export to PowerPoint and PDF even on the free plan, plus basic import | API access on higher plans: Pro and Ultra include API, custom domains and detailed view analytics
Cons: Free credits don't renew: you get 400 non-expiring credits at sign-up; 200 more per referral | Free allows up to 10 slides per prompt; Plus raises it to 100 | 'Made with Gamma' label on the free plan; Plus removes it
Price: Free plan with 400 one-time credits. Paid plan prices not verified. (partly verified)
Model: Subscription with credits
Free: Free plan: 400 non-expiring, non-renewing credits at sign-up, up to 10 slides per prompt, basic import, PPT and PDF export, basic image generation.
Plans: Free: free; Plus: price not verified (1,500 credits/month, up to 100 slides per prompt, removes 'Made with Gamma'); Pro: price not verified (4,000 credits/month, API, up to 10 custom domains, view analytics, headers and footers, password protection); Ultra: price not verified (20,000 credits/month, API, up to 100 custom domains, custom fonts); Business: price not verified
Privacy: On personal accounts (Free, Plus, Pro, Ultra) content may be used by default to train and improve Gamma's models; opt out any time in Account Settings > Data Controls. Business, Enterprise and team content is excluded and the setting is locked.
Rights: Not verified (terms not read).
Watermark: Plus removes the 'Made with Gamma' label, so on Free it appears (inferred from the help page).
API: Yes. Included in Pro and Ultra per the help center. API docs not read.
Hebrew: Per the help center, Gamma supports right-to-left languages including Hebrew, Arabic, Persian and Urdu. You can prompt in Hebrew or pick a language; text aligns right. Mixed RTL/LTR text may need manual fixes.
Students: No official student discount found on the pricing or help pages read.
Community signals: popular
Watch out: Users report the AI says it changed a slide when it changed nothing, and that the refund window is only 3 days.

## 11. Grammarly
https://kleyai.tech/#tool-21 | official: https://www.grammarly.com | Superhuman Platform Inc.
Status: Active. The company behind Grammarly renamed itself Superhuman; Grammarly continues as the writing product inside the Superhuman suite, and almost all existing features stay unchanged per the help center.
What: Writing assistant that fixes grammar and spelling, suggests phrasing and generates text inside the apps and sites you write in.
For: Students, writers and professionals writing in English or other supported languages, alone or in an organization.
Pros: 50% student discount: verified students (via SheerID) get 50% off Grammarly Pro for one subscription term, in a limited-time offer | Free plan with a monthly quota: fixes mistakes, detects tone, 100 AI prompts a month. Pro raises it to 2,000 prompts per user per month | Writing suggestions in 24 languages besides English, included on all plans including free
Cons: Hebrew is not among the 24 supported languages | Rephrasing and originality check are paid only: tone change, full-sentence rewrite, AI detection and plagiarism check are not in the free plan | Content is used for training by default: per the privacy policy Superhuman trains its AI models on collected data; you can control it in account settings
Price: Pro is 12 USD/user/month billed annually, or 15 USD monthly. Free plan with 100 AI prompts a month. (partly verified)
Model: Subscription
Free: Free plan: fixes mistakes, tone detection and 100 AI prompts a month.
Trial: Pro has a free trial with an email reminder two days before it ends. Trial length not stated on the page read.
Plans: Free: free; Pro: 12 USD/month per user billed yearly (Tone change, sentence rewrite, AI detection and plagiarism check, 2,000 AI prompts per user/month); Pro: 15 USD/month per user billed monthly (Same as annual Pro); Business: 33 USD/month per user billed yearly or 40 USD/month per user billed monthly; Enterprise: custom quote
Privacy: Per Superhuman's privacy policy (effective 16 Nov 2026), the company uses collected data to train its AI models, and the user can decide in account training settings whether their content is used. External AI providers are barred from training on customer content. Enterprise and education content is processed under the organization's contract.
Rights: Not verified (terms not read).
API: Not verified.
Hebrew: Source does not mention Hebrew: the help article lists 24 writing-suggestion languages besides English and Hebrew is not among them. It mentions translation too, without a language list. Interface language not checked.
Students: Per the help center, students get 50% off Grammarly Pro in a limited-time offer after SheerID verification. It covers one subscription term, can't be combined with other discounts and doesn't apply to App Store or Google Play purchases.
Community signals: popular, worthwhile free plan

## 12. QuillBot
https://kleyai.tech/#tool-22 | official: https://quillbot.com | QuillBot
What: Writing toolkit: paraphrasing, grammar check, summarizing, AI-text detection and translation.
For: Students and writers working in English or supported languages who need paraphrasing, summarizing and checking.
Pros: Paraphraser works in 23 languages; the translator covers 34 languages including Hebrew, per the help center | Free plan with no credit card: paraphrase up to 125 words in two modes, summarize up to 1,200 words, limited AI detector | One subscription for ten devices: Premium runs on up to 10 devices at once, with a refund up to 3 days for eligible new users
Cons: Hebrew only in the translator: paraphrasing, grammar check, summarizing and plagiarism check don't support it. Grammar check works in English, German, Spanish and French; summarizer in English only | Free word limits: paraphrasing 125 words, summarizing 1,200 words, advanced Humanizer 3 uses | Price varies by region: Premium price depends on region and local currency at checkout
Price: Premium is 8.33 USD/month billed annually. Free plan exists. (partly verified)
Model: Subscription
Free: Free, no credit card: paraphrase up to 125 words in two modes, basic grammar fix, summaries up to 1,200 words, limited AI detection and 3 uses of advanced Humanizer.
Plans: Free: free; Premium: 8.33 USD/month billed yearly (Summaries up to 6,000 words, plagiarism check of 25,000 words/month, unlimited advanced Humanizer, 100MB storage, up to 10 devices at once); Team: custom quote
Privacy: Not verified: privacy policy and terms not read.
Rights: Not verified.
API: Not verified.
Hebrew: Per the help center, Hebrew is supported only in QuillBot's translator (34 languages). The paraphraser supports 23 languages without Hebrew, grammar check English, German, Spanish and French, and summarizer, citations and plagiarism check English only. Interface language and RTL display not mentioned.
Students: The Premium page mentions no student discount.
Community signals: popular, worthwhile free plan

## 13. Beautiful.ai
https://kleyai.tech/#tool-23 | official: https://www.beautiful.ai | Beautiful.ai
What: Presentation builder that lays out design automatically with smart slide templates and generates content with AI.
For: Students and professionals building presentations who want consistent design without manual layout.

Plans: Community Edition: free; Starter: 20 EUR/month billed yearly (2,500 executions per month, unlimited active workflows, 1,600 Assistant credits per month); Pro: 50 EUR/month billed yearly (10,000 executions per month, unlimited active workflows, up to 9,600 Assistant credits per month); Business: 667 EUR/month billed yearly; Enterprise: custom quote
Privacy: Per the AI terms (updated July 6, 2026), n8n will not use customer content or output to train models, but may use prompts and usage data in aggregated, anonymized form to improve AI services. When you connect a third-party provider's model, data goes to it under its terms. In the cloud, data is stored in the EU (Frankfurt), and self-hosting is possible.
Rights: Per the AI terms, the customer owns the output generated in AI features, to the extent the law permits. This is no guarantee against third-party claims.
API: Yes. Docs describe the n8n API for management over HTTP, n8n CLI, an MCP server that connects AI agents and MCP clients to the instance, Workflow SDK and building custom nodes. Limits per plan not stated.

Cons: Unspecified weekly quota on free: the free plan has a weekly word limit and a weekly meeting limit for the Notetaker, but the page gives no numbers | Hebrew only by manual selection: per the help center, select only one language at a time that the tool does not detect from speech, such as Hebrew.
